svg.text: Plate XV — Petrichor: The Blood of the Stone
six panels on the smell of rain on dry earth — drawn by code, seed 20261019
a drop traps air in the pores; bubbles rise,
burst, and launch the scent as aerosol
in beetroot. Same molecule, two tables.
geosmin is an invitation, not a waste product
human threshold ≈ 5 ppt (5 ng per litre of water)
one dedicated lock for this one earthy key
the nose is not general-purpose here. It is tuned.
lightning splits O₂ → ozone rides the downdraft first;
then rain frees geosmin and the oils plants
laid down all through the dry spell
a storm, read as a chord: bright, deep, green
mitti attar: no flower, no rain —
steam through fired earth, caught in oil
